argentina_brazil.scene: Iguazu Falls seen from the Brazilian side across to the Argentine cascades, low river-level viewpoint beside wet subtropical rocks with a delicate rainbow in drifting mist, soft early morning sidelight.

argentina_brazil_chile.alt: Каскады Игуасу на границе Аргентины и Бразилии
argentina_brazil_chile.scene: Iguazu Falls on the Argentina-Brazil border, intimate elevated oblique view along a row of powerful cascades with a broad dark-green rainforest canopy and backlit white mist, cloudy silver-blue morning. Connect Argentina and Brazil within this three-country route.

argentina_brazil_chile_peru.scene: Shared Argentine-Chilean Patagonia: a pair of guanacos beside a turquoise glacial lake beneath layered snow-covered Andean peaks, very wide windswept open steppe, late afternoon amber light, low eye-level perspective. A coherent Patagonia scene linking Argentina and Chile, without unrelated monuments.

argentina_brazil_chile_uruguay.alt: Горная дорога через Анды Аргентины и Чили
argentina_brazil_chile_uruguay.scene: The Andes between Argentina and Chile, a serpentine high mountain road below monumental layered reddish rock walls and distant snowy summits, clear deep blue sky, road curves from lower right towards central pass, no close vehicles, warm side lighting.

argentina_brazil_peru.scene: Vast Amazon basin shared by Brazil and Peru: a graceful dark river bend through unbroken tropical rainforest, a small traditional wooden riverboat in the middle distance, low aerial cinematic view, pale sunrise mist hovering over trees, authentic lush humid nature.

argentina_brazil_uruguay.scene: Broad Rio de la Plata estuary shared by Argentina and Uruguay: a white sailing yacht crosses calm silver water, distant low historic Colonia del Sacramento coastline and lighthouse, apricot dusk with lavender clouds, camera at water level from a second boat, tranquil authentic river travel.

argentina_chile.alt: Андские вершины и озеро в Патагонии
argentina_chile.scene: Shared Argentina-Chile Patagonia: majestic snow-covered Andean mountains rising behind a pale turquoise lake, lenga forest with autumn gold along a rocky shore in foreground, crisp dawn side lighting, cinematic wide travel photograph, no famous peaks combined incorrectly.

argentina_chile_peru.scene: High Andes spanning Peru, Chile and Argentina: a small herd of vicunas on a golden altiplano plain with a brilliant cobalt high-altitude lake and distant snow-covered volcanic cone, low camera at animal eye height, clear high mountain light, authentic documentary nature scene.

argentina_chile_uruguay.alt: Маяк и горные берега пролива Бигль
argentina_chile_uruguay.scene: Beagle Channel in Tierra del Fuego shared by Argentina and Chile: low red-and-white navigation lighthouse on a rocky island surrounded by a few sea lions, layered dark mountains on both sides of a narrow sea channel, storm clouds opening to a warm shaft of sunset light, distant view with ample landscape.

argentina_peru.alt: Ламы и террасные поля в Андах
argentina_peru.scene: Andean cultural landscape linking Argentina and Peru: terraced highland fields in muted ochre and green, dry-stone walls, a small group of llamas on an old mountain trail beneath rolling high Andes, soft golden dawn mist, documentary travel photography, no Machu Picchu or other monument falsely placed in Argentina.
